title: How to pay your Airbnb cleaners: rates, payment methods and the 1099-NEC basics
summary: How to pay Airbnb cleaners: flat vs hourly rates, payment methods, and the 2026 Form 1099-NEC rules ($2,000 threshold, January 31 deadline).
body_markdown:
**Most hosts pay cleaners a flat rate per turnover, settle up weekly or monthly by bank transfer or a payment app, and send a Form 1099-NEC in January to any independent cleaner they paid $2,000 or more during 2026. Among rental businesses that track cleaning costs in ProhostAI, 98% of priced turnover cleans were flat-rate, and the median was $145 per clean. Here's how to set rates, pick a payment method, and stay on the right side of the IRS.**


*Tax rules as of November 2026, for US hosts. This is general information, not tax advice; check with your accountant.*
